name: TurboScribe
shortDescription: Fast, accurate transcription of audio and video files.
bestFor: Turning recordings into text quickly and cheaply, with a generous free plan
about: TurboScribe turns audio and video files into text. You upload a recording, such as a lecture, interview or voice note, and get a transcript you can download in many formats, including subtitles.
It supports many languages, and its paid plan has no fixed limit on how much you transcribe.
features: Export as Word, PDF, TXT or SRT subtitles

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at turboscribe.ai.

howToUse.title: Upload a file
howToUse.text: Upload an audio or video file, or paste a link.

howToUse.title: Choose the language
howToUse.text: Pick the spoken language and turn on speaker labels if there is more than one speaker.

howToUse.title: Download
howToUse.text: When it is done, read the transcript and export it.

tips: Clear audio with less background noise gives much better results.
Use SRT export to add subtitles in CapCut or YouTube.
limitations: Free files are limited to 30 minutes each and 3 per day.
Mixed Urdu and English speech can have more mistakes.
freePlanDetails: 3 files per day, up to 30 minutes each.

name: Otter.ai
shortDescription: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarises meetings.
bestFor: Live notes and summaries of Zoom, Google Meet and Teams meetings
about: Otter.ai joins your online meetings, writes a live transcript, and gives you a summary and action items at the end.
You can also record in-person conversations on your phone and search all your past meetings.
useCases: Find what was said in an old meeting
features: Joins Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create an account at otter.ai and connect your calendar.

howToUse.title: Let it join meetings
howToUse.text: Otter's assistant can join scheduled meetings automatically, or you can add it to one.

howToUse.title: Or record on your phone
howToUse.text: Use the app to record an in-person meeting or lecture.

howToUse.title: Review the summary
howToUse.text: After the meeting, read the summary and share it.

tips: Always tell people the meeting is being recorded.
Add special words and names to its vocabulary for better accuracy.
limitations: Works best in English. Other languages are limited.
Free conversations are limited to 30 minutes.
freePlanDetails: 300 minutes per month, up to 30 minutes per conversation.

name: Fireflies.ai
shortDescription: Meeting notetaker that transcribes, summarises and searches calls.
bestFor: Teams that want searchable notes from every call, in many languages
about: Fireflies.ai joins your video calls, records and transcribes them, and makes summaries with action items. It supports many languages and connects to tools like Slack, CRMs and Notion.
It is popular with sales and support teams who want to search what customers said.
useCases: Sending notes to Slack or a CRM
features: Works with Zoom, Meet and Teams

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create an account at fireflies.ai and connect your calendar.

howToUse.title: Choose which meetings to join
howToUse.text: Set it to join all meetings or only the ones you pick.

howToUse.title: Read the notes
howToUse.text: After each call, read the summary and transcript.

howToUse.title: Connect your apps
howToUse.text: Send notes automatically to Slack, Notion or your CRM.

tips: Use topic trackers to find calls where a word, such as "price", came up.
limitations: AI features on the paid plan use credits.
The free plan has limited storage and summaries.
freePlanDetails: Free transcription with limited storage and AI summaries.
